programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Shot Through The Heart
programmes.d: A jewelry shop owner is shot point blank in the chest during a robbery and within minutes is undergoing emergency open-heart surgery.
A patient arrives with paralysis in her legs; a boy is crushed by an ATV and the hospital doesn't have the right equipment to treat him; a doctor accidentally injects herself with epinephrine.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Diagnose Me
programmes.d: A teen is bleeding internally from an ectopic pregnancy, but denies ever having sex, so her doctor must find a clever way to prove her pregnancy before he can treat her. A young mother mysteriously goes in and out of flatline.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Liver Die
programmes.d: Jarret is rushed into ER after being violently tackled in a football game. A CAT scan reveals that his liver is split and he needs emergency surgery.
An unsolved double murder becomes Vancouver's most notorious cold case when a worker discovers a shallow grave in a famous park.
After a front desk worker at a North Dakota motel is found brutally murdered, the search for their killer will span decades over several states and employ new techniques.
The chilling story of Mark Martin, who murdered three homeless women in his quest to become Nottingham's first serial killer.
In 1977, Angus Sinclair kidnapped, raped and murdered two seventeen-year-old girls after meeting them in a pub in Glasgow, Scotland.
Experienced climbers are in the Swiss Alps when they are caught up in a terrifying electrical storm.

In 1982, 5 people got caught in a tropical storm. Their yacht sinks, they must survive in the middle of the Ocean. To their absolute horror, they find the area of the ocean to be infested with sharks.
In 2003, David Hunt and his daughter Leia, set off on a snowmobiling adventure in the Quebec backcountry.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Crowbar In Head
programmes.d: A man is impaled through the skull with a crowbar; a woman's cough turns out to be an internal worm infection; a bride is sewn into her wedding dress, and refuses to take it off, even though she needs treatment for a kidney stone.

A paralyzed stroke patient watches speechless and horrified as his wife and his 2 girlfriends fight over him; Army doctors in Iraq try to save the lives of 3 soldiers who lost limbs in an IED explosion.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Twists & Turns
programmes.d: A violent convict may be faking paralysis as part of a prison escape plan; a young man seems to be suffocating for no apparent reason; a father is stabbed in the heart trying to protect his son; a college cheerleader mysteriously goes into cardiac arrest.
A serial predator leaves a trail of bodies along the southeastern United States.
